name: decompress
description: CommonJS shim that replaces the unmaintained and vulnerable 'decompress' package (GHSA-mp2f-45pm-3cg9, GHSA-h39j-r5qq-r9mm, GHSA-jwp9-9v96-94mx) with its maintained fork '@xhmikosr/decompress'. Wired in through the 'overrides' section of ../../package.json; only used by @kiota-community/kiota-gen to unpack the kiota binary.
